financial_base.basis: FY 2025 GAAP diluted EPS used as conservative normalized core EPS base
financial_base.normalization_note: TTM GAAP EPS of $19.15 is distorted by +$126.8B non-operating investment gains in OI&E (9M-2026), making the headline P/E of 14.6x misleading. FY 2025 GAAP diluted EPS of $10.80 (S&P Global Market Intelligence via StockAnalysis, updated Oct 29 2026) excludes these 2026 non-operating gains and represents the core earnings power of the business. Used as a conservative normalized base; the operating business has likely grown since FY 2025, so the true core TTM EPS may be higher. Source data verified: Revenue TTM $471.1B, Net income TTM $235.7B, FY2025 EPS $10.80.
